quote: Anti-inflammatory mechanisms are a direct implementation path for inflammation-reduction objectives.
Cartilage-preservation objectives are implemented through cartilage matrix support mechanisms.
Synovial lubrication goals are operationalized through joint lubrication pathways.
Skin barrier objectives map directly to epidermal support mechanisms.
Oxidative reduction objectives map to antioxidant defense mechanisms.
Tear stability objectives are partially implemented by oxidative load reduction pathways.
Gut microbiome objectives map to microbiome-support mechanisms.
Lean mass maintenance objectives map to muscle recovery and adaptation mechanisms.
paper: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
